parameters.name: Description
parameters.description: The description of the device label. The description can contain letters, digits, Chinese characters, spaces, periods (.), underscores (_), and hyphens (-). This parameter can be left empty.

parameters.name: DynamicOperator
parameters.description: The operator of the dynamic device group rule.

parameters.name: DynamicRule
parameters.description: The matching rule of the dynamic device label.

parameters.name: GroupType
parameters.description:
The type of the device label. Valid values:

- **static**: static device label. After creation, manually add terminal devices by calling [AddDeviceGroupMatchDevices](~~AddDeviceGroupMatchDevices~~).
- **dynamic**: dynamic device label. Members are automatically matched by the DynamicRule matching rule.

parameters.name: Name
parameters.description: The name of the device label. The name must be 1 to 128 characters in length and can contain letters, digits, Chinese characters, periods (.), underscores (_), and hyphens (-). Spaces are not supported.
